title: Battle of Castiglione (1706)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Castiglione (1706)", at revision 1370436540, opens: "The Battle of Castiglione took place near Castiglione delle Stiviere in Lombardy, Italy on 9 September 1706 during the War of the Spanish Succession. A French army of 12,000 attacked a Hessian corps of 10,000 that was besieging the town and forced them to retreat with heavy losses." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q701808, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle of 1706 during the War of Spanish Succession". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
